Frequently Asked Questions

Are Divine Hindu's products authentic and certified?

Yes. Our Rudraksha, gemstones, and Karungali are sourced from trusted origins and come with government-approved lab certification where applicable. Every certified item ships with its authenticity documentation so you know exactly what you're receiving.

Are the products energised before shipping?

Yes. Our spiritual products are cleansed and energised following traditional Vedic rituals before they reach you, so they are ready to use on arrival.

Do you ship across India and internationally?

We ship across India with free shipping, and we deliver to many international destinations. Delivery timelines and any customs charges vary by location and are shown at checkout.

How long does delivery take?

Most orders within India are dispatched within 24-48 hours and delivered in 3-7 business days depending on your location. You'll receive tracking once your order ships.

What is your return and refund policy?

If something arrives damaged or isn't as described, contact us within the window noted on our Returns page and we'll arrange a replacement or refund. Certain energised or personal items may have conditions for hygiene and spiritual-integrity reasons.

How do I choose the right Rudraksha or gemstone for me?

You can shop by purpose (peace, protection, wealth, health) or by your rashi (zodiac). If you're unsure, our team can guide you via chat or the contact details on our site.

How do I care for and cleanse my mala or bracelet?

Keep beads away from water, perfume, and harsh chemicals, and wipe gently with a soft dry cloth. Many devotees recharge their beads periodically in sunlight or moonlight and by chanting the associated mantra.

Is Divine Hindu a trusted store?

Divine Hindu (Divinehindu Lifestyle Private Limited) is trusted by lakhs of devotees across India, with certified products, secure payments, and responsive customer support.
